description:
I wrote “Matter” when the protests started happening nationally for this resurgence of the Black Live Matter movement. I was creating a lot of art, at the time, (both visual and sonic) in tribute to Breonna Taylor, George Floyd, Ahmaud Arbery etc…A lot of the visuals used in the video are those very same pieces. The song was brought to life by producer Sam Hoffman (Mereba). 

Proceeds from this tune are going to Abundant Beginnings: https://givebutter.com/ABUNDANTBEGINNINGS
and Sista Afya: www.bufi.org
credits:
Written by Brittany Campbell
Produced by Sam Hoffman and Brittany Campbell
